verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair question for an online government service with accounts, payment rails, and machine filing channels, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows user-defined rules, triggers, webhooks, or event-driven actions. The machine channels (MeF, IRIS A2A) are credentialed submission rails, not automation engines, and EFTPS appears only as a bare listing with no scheduling or trigger details.
